services.name: OC Banana Boat
services.desc: Duration 50 minutes About Get Wet & have a Blast as you TUBE across the waters of Ocean City-- bouncing & power sliding -- on OC' Original & only 12 passenger inflatable Banana raft pulled by our powerboat named Jaws. Our fun-loving, friendly, safety-minded crew will take riders out for some FUN on the water. The excursion takes about 50 minutes, start to finish; including a 10 minute boat ride to the tubing area, 30 minutes of playtime, and a 10 minute return boat ride. We travel up the coast of OC-- family & friends will likely see you from the beach. Rough seas can result in bay rides (which are just as fun). If you are on a private trip you can choose (weather permitting). Ages 5 and up
